task.description: Implement EXT-01 backend behavior according to src/design/ext-01-service-task-node.md. Add SERVICE_TASK node execution support with outbound HTTP invocation (URL/method/optional headers), default timeout 30s with timeout_ms override, no automatic redirect following (3xx treated as failures), retry with exponential backoff (default retries=3, configurable per node), and terminal failure handling that writes to OBS-05 DLQ then transitions instance to ERROR per EE-10. On HTTP 2xx responses, merge JSON object response into instance variables per EE-09; when a 2xx body is not a JSON object, transition to ERROR. Include trace_id propagation in outbound request headers per API-09 and enforce activation-time validation for empty resolved URL template edge case. Ensure retry safety/idempotency protections align with the design. Keep SQL security guarantees (prepared statements only) and avoid I/O in src/engine/transition.zig.
acceptance_criteria: No error-set propagation gaps remain (zig build stderr has no error-set warnings)
EXT-01 acceptance criteria and listed edge cases are implemented as designed

result.summary: Implemented EXT-01 groundwork only: SERVICE_TASK attribute validation was aligned to defaults and compatibility rules, and a new service-task helper module with retry/idempotency primitives plus unit tests was added. Full runtime execution path is not yet integrated.

issues.description: SERVICE_TASK execution is not wired into instance runtime (no outbound HTTP attempt orchestration from activation through retries/backoff).
Terminal retry exhaustion path is not yet connected to OBS-05 DLQ persistence and EE-10 ERROR transition as one integrated flow.
Trace propagation and deterministic idempotency header behavior are implemented as helpers but not yet applied on real outbound HTTP requests.

result.next_action: Route to BACKEND-DEV rework to integrate SERVICE_TASK runtime into engine instance lifecycle and complete end-to-end EXT-01 acceptance criteria.
